detector: MediaPipe BlazeFace short-range float16 v1, IMAGE CPU, min confidence 0.5
resize: Pillow separable antialiased bilinear, 22-bit coefficients, byte rounding after each pass
crop: side=int(max(w,h)*1.2); left=int(cx-side/2); top=int(cy-side/2); square black padding; no landmark alignment
detector_distribution: MediaPipe differs from original Haar. Expansion is an explicit port of the old crop rule, not evidence of detector equivalence. See validation report.
